name: Sounflame
look: a little red bat with huge pointed ears, a yellow mask and beaky muzzle, magenta eyes and wings of yellow-orange flame
entry: Its huge ears hear the crackle of a campfire from a mile away. It sneaks up to warm its wings by the flames and steals the sparks to feed its own.
how: One of the A. Fakemon starters: pick it at the starter screen (its own A. Fakemon page).
Wild: very rare in badlands, savannas and deserts.
